subject: Intermediary processor addition — residency banding & evidence request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finvault.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finvault.com
Date: Fri, 8 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New intermediary processor for telemetry routing — notice and residency question

Hi Karthik,

Quick heads-up: our infrastructure team is planning to introduce EdgeBridge (a telemetry relay operated by EdgeBridge Inc.) as an intermediary processor for non-production telemetry ingestion for our Redwood integration. We understand this is a change of processor and want to provide the details up-front so your security/compliance team can validate.

High level:
- Purpose: short-lived telemetry aggregation for debugging and metrics enrichment (non-customer-data tokenized)
- Residency: EdgeBridge runs primarily in eu-west-1 and us-west-2; they also have a processing node in ireland that may receive buffered telemetry for debugging.
- Timeline: target cutover for dev/staging on 2029-03-20, production pilot 2029-04-02

I've attached a simple dataflow diagram and their connector datasheet. Can you confirm whether introducing a relay that touches buffered telemetry in Ireland requires a DPA addendum or any export controls from Redwood's side? Also, what evidence/package would you need to close this loop (attestations, SOC-type report, encryption details)?

Thanks — hoping to keep this lightweight but compliant.

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, FinVault
liam.oconnor@finvault.com

Attachments: dataflow-finvault.svg, edgebridge-connector-datasheet.pdf

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 8 Mar 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New intermediary processor for telemetry routing — notice and residency question

Thanks Liam — looping in Lauren (privacy) and Kimberly (security) to scope.

Lauren / Kim,

Summary: FinVault wants to add EdgeBridge as a telemetry relay that may process buffered telemetry from eu nodes (Ireland) and us-west. Primarily dev/staging but pilot to prod soon. They attached a dataflow + datasheet. Key asks from FinVault:
- Do we need a DPA addendum for EdgeBridge touching buffered telemetry in Ireland?
- What evidence do we require (SOC 2 type, encryption-at-rest keys, subprocessor roster, onshore fallback)?

My initial take: because this is non-customer PII telemetry tokenized, we may be able to handle as a processing subcontractor under our existing DPA if EdgeBridge is a downstream subprocessor with appropriate controls and attestations. But we need:
1) EdgeBridge subprocessor declaration + location footprint (specific Ireland region details)
2) Encryption and key management details (do they have KMS separation?)
3) SOC2 comp/ISO or equivalent; if not available, compensating controls and a short checklist

Kimberly — can you start a short evidence checklist we can send them? If this touches eu-resident telemetry in any form we should confirm export paths and onshore fallback. Rafael, flag to infra for routing constraints if we need to block buffered copies.

I'll respond to FinVault with those asks unless you want to take it.

— Karthik
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New intermediary processor for telemetry routing — notice and residency question

Karthik / Lauren — draft checklist below we should send to FinVault. I kept it concise to avoid back-and-forth.

Required items (please provide as attachments or direct links):
- EdgeBridge subprocessor declaration (legal name, contact, country of incorporation)
- Processing footprint by region (do they actually persist any EU telemetry outside eu-west-1 / ie-central?)
- SOC 2 Type II report or ISO 27001 certificate (most recent) OR (if unavailable) completed security questionnaire + three customer references
- Encryption details: at-rest encryption algorithm, KMS provider, whether keys are customer-separable (Y/N)
- Data retention policy for buffered telemetry (max retention, deletion guarantees)
- Onshore fallback plan (how will EdgeBridge avoid EU residency if requested by a customer)
- Network egress paths & any known subprocessor chain (do they call downstream analytics or storage providers?)

Optional (helps speed review):
- Dataflow diagram with IP ranges and S3/bucket names redacted
- SLA/uptime for relay

If FinVault can provide the top 5 bullets within 5 business days we can triage and route for a DPA addendum if needed. Rafael — can infra team confirm whether Redwood’s telemetry routing can be pinned to region to prevent cross-border buffering if requested?

Kimberly Park
Sr. Security PM, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finvault.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finvault.com
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New intermediary processor for telemetry routing — notice and residency question

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Karthik/Kim.

We can provide:
- EdgeBridge subprocessor declaration + country of incorporation (EdgeBridge Inc., Ireland)
- Processing footprint by region (they confirm primary nodes in eu-west-1 and us-west-2; buffering may occur in eu-central-1 (Ireland) for troubleshooting)
- SOC2 Type II (current) attached — see edgebridge-connector-datasheet.pdf for the attestation pointer
- Encryption details: AES-256 at rest; keys managed by EdgeBridge KMS (they do not allow customer-supplied keys today)
- Retention: default 7 days for buffered telemetry, configurable down to 24 hours
- Onshore fallback: EdgeBridge offers a paid onshore-only routing option (requires contract addendum)
- They call one downstream analytics vendor (SignalFold) — we can provide contact and agreement text if needed.

Timeline: we can gather the formal declarations and the redacted dataflow by end of day Friday (2029-03-15). Pilot cutover stays at 2029-03-20 for dev/staging unless Redwood requires additional gating.

If you need any sample contract language for the addendum let me know and I can have procurement share a draft.

Best,
Liam
Head of Integrations, FinVault

Attachments: SOC2-EdgeBridge-2028-summary.pdf (referenced inside datasheet)
